content: Test-Driven Development — write failing test first (RED), then minimal code (GREEN), then refactor. Mandatory in RaiSE with no exceptions.

metadata.name: TDD
metadata.description: Test-Driven Development — write failing test first (RED), then minimal code (GREEN), then refactor. Mandatory in RaiSE with no exceptions.

content: Human-In-The-Loop — mandatory pause for human review at design and implement pipeline gates. AI agents must not self-approve HITL gates.

metadata.name: HITL
metadata.description: Human-In-The-Loop — mandatory pause for human review at design and implement pipeline gates. AI agents must not self-approve HITL gates.

content: Automated quality checkpoint that must pass before proceeding. Includes tests (scoped), lint, format, and types. Run exclusively via `rai gate check`.

metadata.name: Gate
metadata.description: Automated quality checkpoint that must pass before proceeding. Includes tests (scoped), lint, format, and types. Run exclusively via `rai gate check`.

content: Distributable unit of domain knowledge containing schema, corpus, extractors, and instances. Installed per-project under .raise/cartridges/.

metadata.name: Cartridge
metadata.description: Distributable unit of domain knowledge containing schema, corpus, extractors, and instances. Installed per-project under .raise/cartridges/.

content: A unit of work in the RaiSE backlog representing one deployable increment. Stories follow the full pipeline (start → design → plan → implement → review → close) and branch from the development branch.

metadata.name: Story
metadata.description: A unit of work in the RaiSE backlog representing one deployable increment. Stories follow the full pipeline (start → design → plan → implement → review → close) and branch from the development branch.

content: A logical container grouping related stories toward a shared objective. Epics are not branches — they are directories under work/epics/ and tracker entries. Stories within an epic branch from the development branch, not from an epic branch.

metadata.name: Epic
metadata.description: A logical container grouping related stories toward a shared objective. Epics are not branches — they are directories under work/epics/ and tracker entries. Stories within an epic branch from the development branch, not from an epic branch.

content: An isolated git checkout under .worktree/ bound to a mission. One worktree per mission, reused across epics and stories until the mission objectives are met.

metadata.name: Worktree
metadata.description: An isolated git checkout under .worktree/ bound to a mission. One worktree per mission, reused across epics and stories until the mission objectives are met.

content: Merge Request — the mechanism for integrating a story branch into the development branch. Created exclusively via `/rai-mr-create` after the full gate suite passes.

metadata.name: MR
metadata.description: Merge Request — the mechanism for integrating a story branch into the development branch. Created exclusively via `/rai-mr-create` after the full gate suite passes.

content: The `--scope <path>` flag on `rai gate check gate-tests` that restricts test execution to a specific directory. Required for per-task and per-story gate runs to prevent context flooding.

metadata.name: Scope (gate)
metadata.description: The `--scope <path>` flag on `rai gate check gate-tests` that restricts test execution to a specific directory. Required for per-task and per-story gate runs to prevent context flooding.

content: Stop-the-line principle — stop and fix defects immediately when detected. Do not accumulate errors or defer fixes. A failing gate means stop, not continue.

metadata.name: Jidoka
metadata.description: Stop-the-line principle — stop and fix defects immediately when detected. Do not accumulate errors or defer fixes. A failing gate means stop, not continue.

content: The integration target for all story merges. Currently release/3.1.0. Stories branch from and merge back to this branch. Main receives only tested, released code.
